title: Christmas Market at Blackpool Cricket Club
description: Stalls are fully sold out! Please come along for a gorgeous festive afternoon, supporting small businesses. Plenty of gorgeous stalls, gifting, sweet treats, decorations etc. The bar is open and you could even book yourself a table for Sunday lunch! Sunday 15 November, 1pm-5pm at Blackpool Cricket Club. Free entry. Raising money for Mind. Blackpool Cricket Club on Facebook →

title: Christmas Market at Christ King Church
location: Christ King Church, 241 Bispham Road, Blackpool FY2 0LB
description: Lots of handmade gifts, unique finds and treats, with something for everyone. A great way to get a head start on your Christmas shopping while supporting local small businesses. Stalls so far include Boo Blooms, Resin by Olivia, Bling by Amy, Inner Sparkle, The Dessert Lab and more, with Mr Whippy Blackpool outside serving ice creams and waffles. Saturday 21 November 2026, 11am-3pm. Free entry.

title: Music & Memory Social at Layton Library
description: A new dementia-inclusive social for older residents, families and carers. Nostalgic songs, cherished memories, gentle singalongs and a lovely brew and a chat. Every Saturday at Layton Library from 28 November 2026, 10:30am-12:30pm. No singing skills needed.

title: 20p Toy Sale at the Re-use Shop
location: Re-use Shop, Bristol Avenue, Bispham (just outside Layton)
description: Enveco is holding a 20p Toy Sale at its Re-use Shop, just outside Layton, with every good-quality pre-loved toy just 20p and up to 10 toys per person. Saturday 12 December, 10:30am-3:30pm at the Re-use Shop, Household Waste Recycling Centre, Bristol Avenue, Bispham, FY2 0JG. Children must be accompanied by an adult.

title: Free Christmas Party at The Victory Pub
location: The Victory Pub, Caunce Street, Blackpool
description: Blackpool Mums & Babies by Ameelia invite everyone to a free Christmas party to say a huge thank you to the community. Free disco, free buffet, free face painting and a free visit from Santa, plus games, dancing and festive fun. Sunday 29 November, 2pm-5pm at The Victory Pub, Caunce Street, Blackpool. Donations welcome, never expected, supporting the Christmas Present Drive and future community activities.

title: Festive Family Fun Day at Layton Institute
description: Streetlife invite families to a free Festive Family Fun Day at Layton Institute. Santa's Grotto, Christmas crafts, festive games, Christmas gifts, raffle and tombola, cake stall, hot food and a lucky dip. Sunday 29 November, 1pm-4pm. Free entry, and every penny raised supports Streetlife and the young people they help across Blackpool.

title: Festive Express 2026
description: BFriend & Wellbeing, part of Community First, invite local families to a free festive afternoon with a toy station, teen station, Christmas Eve boxes, wrapping station, festive family food ideas and crafts and activities. Thursday 3 December, 2pm-5:30pm at Forest Gate Baptist Church, Blackpool. All free of charge. Donations of toys, gifts, wrapping supplies, toiletries and long-life food are being collected at Community First, Abingdon Street, until Wednesday 2 December.
